classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round brackets the manifest read between barrier.wait() calls, so every rank sits at the following barrier until the slowest rank's manifest read completes, and each round uses a distinct manifest path (manifest(workdir, r, placing)) so a given file is only read once by a rank.

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: The sidecar reads happen in a plain for-loop after the manifest barriers with no synchronization primitive, so a rank blocks only itself on os.pread via _read while other ranks continue their own loop iterations, and since the same sidecar path (independent of round index r) is re-read inside the outer 'for r in range(cell.rounds)' loop, a given file is accessed ROUNDS=200 times by that rank.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: Like the sidecar loop, the shard reads use _read with no barrier around them, so only the calling rank waits on the open/pread/close sequence, and because shard(workdir, me, i) does not depend on the round index, the same shard file is re-read once per round for all ROUNDS=200 rounds by that rank.
